ops.title: capt-hook 9.16.0 + 9.25.0 — PR routing follows change shape (edit→hook's home repo, new hook→repo-local, universality bar for pack edits); target-keyed PR cap + review slots; auto-enroll; plugin.json bump AUTOMATED by the release workflow as of 9.25.

ops.body:
Two-wave routing overhaul answering "why do review PRs only target captain-hook". 9.16.0 (2026-07-15): killed the generic-create→general-pack route, target-keyed open-PR cap (`open_pr_targets`, pr_url-parsed, sole counting codepath), `review slots` pre-PR gate, auto-enroll in `review run`, unwatched-session status canary. 9.25.0 (2026-07-16) refined the axis per user correction — routing follows **change shape**, not candidate kind: every create candidate takes a mandatory overlap check (`capt-hook hooks` inventory + repo-local sources) before drafting; an already-covered rule skips; a **universal** broadening of a pack hook becomes an edit PR'd against the pack's repo (universality bar: justification citing this repo's tooling/conventions/user phrasing → not universal; uncertain → repo-local); only new hooks land as new `.claude/hooks/` files. authoring-hooks gained EXTEND mode (broaden + new test pair, message byte-identical, existing tests untouched). Fix-kind scan-time routing (routing: line, repo_key/origin_repo_key) unchanged.

**Why:** the fleet's PR skew was ~80% policy, not bug — check the skill prompt before the code when brain behavior looks wrong. The change-shape refinement exists because kind-based routing forced duplicate repo-local hooks when the right change was broadening an existing pack hook.

**How to apply:** plugin.json bumping is AUTOMATED since 9.25.0 — the release workflow's `sync-plugin-version` job commits `version`=tag back to main (verified live: 9.23.0→9.25.0, one-line diff, zero CI triggered — GITHUB_TOKEN pushes start no workflows); never hand-bump, and `git pull` after releasing. `capt-hook hooks` output (6-col TSV) is brain contract pinned in review-cli.md — additive only; framework registrations omitted; LLM-hook messages are closure-held so their rows screen by name/file. Accepted residuals: create-as-pack-edit consumes a pack slot but gates eligibility on the watched repo (the `review slots --repo <target>` check is the sole pack-cap enforcement); its row keeps repo_key=watched, no routing line. Local `great-docs build` broken by the .gd-build fragment gap (papercut filed); docs CI is the gate. Related: [[review-overhaul-wave-shipped]], [[capt-hook-release-rollout-gotchas]].
